method: (method around lines 1610-1688 handling tool call execution and permission checking)
intended_behavior: Refactor permission checking to use an onion-style middleware hook "on_check_permission". The method should pass the validated `tool_call`, resolved `tool`, and parsed `tool_input` to the middleware hook. Middleware can call `next_handler` to continue the chain, replace or short-circuit permission decisions. The PermissionEngine.check_permission remains the innermost handler. The method should preserve existing functionality when no middleware is attached and properly handle calls resumed after prior user confirmation by traversing the middleware chain with an allow decision without re-invoking the engine.
Add the "on_check_permission" middleware hook method to the Agent class implementing the standard onion middleware pattern, enabling observation and modification of permission decisions at runtime.
